# Chapter Five: Getting To Know You

Sowain sat in the chair in the old house in Rockville, he had been the Alpha for this pack in America since the revolutionary war. Only a few of the originals were left others had been killed or had gone onto become rogue. Sowain was not his original name, in fact he had changed it several times, this was for both his safety and for that of his lineage. Human and Wolf alike, He waited impatiently for his recon patrol to report in after the operation this morning. He always had them report in person, he did not trust cell phones and knew about the listening station at Fort Meade, though he did not think the order had anyone in there, it was better to be safe. He looked at the computer screen which showed a computer generated family tree complete with DNA results, he had pulled this one from multiple sources, the longer he was alive the easier it was to track down one’s relatives. This was both a blessing and a problem, there were others, Alpha’s and princes alike who would kill to know what he knew and more importantly, kill who he was trying to protect.

This was a hairy business, he did not have an actual kinship to his human family, but there was a reason that the line had survived, he was sure of it. And despite what he had become he did have a belief in the almighty and that there was a plan. His part was to ensure that his line survived. His pack knew little of what was going on in this case and it would have to remain that way, he was not sure if anyone of them might have been approached by one of the princes. He sipped his brandy and seemed to look through the machine as he counted the number of family lines he had tried to protect and failed. Only a few had actually survived and only one he knew was well hidden. This one had been a surprise, when the DNA result had popped up he was sure it had been intercepted by others, but so far no one had made a move, it was the lineage that caught his eye and he knew, he was not the only wolf watching these things carefully.

He had waited a year before moving back towards the east coast and then another few months confirming the individual and also setting up this little show. His own Alpha who actually was a distant relative of his would have wanted this line removed immediately, but Sowain had other plans. He would have to approach this one carefully if he was to relocate this line and hide them. That was the only way.

The recon pack returned and filled him in, When Marcus mentioned the smell Sowain tensed but didn’t give any more away. He thanked them and dismissed the group. He knew Rebecca was tailing him and would get the address he needed.

Brock

Brock headed for the door “Brock, where are you off to my child” Sowain asked Brock turned and with a sheepish look “I hate being cooped up and, well I have some human needs to satisfy” he answered smiling. Sowain knew all too well such desires and with a smile dismissed the beta to carry on. Sowain went back to staring at the monitor and sipping his drink, he needed a plan to approach this one, he knew all too well the information he would have to bestow on him would be a shock to say the least.

Brock took off down the street and once he knew he wasn’t being followed he flipped open the burner phone and dialed a number “What do you have to report” the voice on the other end asked simply, coldly Brock swallowed hard, he never liked making a call to this one, he was old and he was scary as hell, but the reward was worth the risk. “I think he found him, one of the beta’s is tailing him now, what do you want me to do?” he asked, looking around to see if anyone from the house had bothered to follow him, he didn’t think he was suspected, but better safe than sorry. “Watch her, ensure you get the address of this individual, then call me with it, is that understood” brock nodded and then realized he was on a phone “yes sir, and the reward we talked about?” he asked hopeful. “Brock, your pack will require a new alpha should what I think be proven true come to pass, do not worry, I don’t forget my friends” and then the line went dead.

Brock swallowed hard and then pulled his Dyna Glide onto the road to head back to the park. For many years those of his kind had chosen a nomadic lifestyle, since the late 60’s that had been the way of the biker, someone who could pass through a city or country with little notice allowing them to stay outside of society as a whole, this also lent itself to the mentality of the pack, since gangs were not uncommon, though things had gotten easier since the late 80’s when biker gangs were synonymous with the hells angels and outlaw groups in general, now that most gangs consisted of dentists and doctors and those who could afford the luxury of owning an expensive motorcycle, passing through smaller areas unmolested by law enforcement had become much easier.

Brock himself still remembered a time when it was the open west and the dreams of getting rich off of California gold were fresh in everyone’s mind and aside from a few comrades a pistol on your hip and a horse underneath you, it was a lot easier to go unnoticed or to even change your identity. But that had been the wild west. Things had changed a lot since then.

He picked up his pace weaving through traffic to see if he could still catch Rebecca at the entrance to the park. Hopefully she and the man she was tailing would still be there. He still didn’t know how he wanted to handle it, He didn’t want to just approach her and tell her that Alpha had ordered him to help, because if she ever brought that up, it would unravel really fast. So he figured he would tail her and by proxy him. All he needed was an address after all.

Since the traffic was lighter later into the morning it took Brock no time at all to get there. This allowed him to think and reflect more on his deal with the old Wolf. He had been approached a few years ago with a simple proposition, watch Sowain and report anything he does that falls outside of ordinary pack business. Brock wasn’t stupid he had been around long enough to know the old Wolf was circumventing the efforts of his Alpha.

When his Alpha went to protect someone, most of the time the address made its way to the Old Wife, who happen to be Sowain’s sire and then the family would disappear or be found murdered. So far Sowain had not caught on and with this latest one, it appears the Old Wolf might be ready to allow a change of leadership, Brock would take Sowain’s place once he had been dealt with by his sire.

It suited him, he would be pack leader and he would have pick of the bitches, first and foremost would be that Rebecca, she always shunned him much to his chagrin but she wouldn’t have a choice, she would belong to the alpha. A Wolfish grin spread across his face, for lack of a better description and he gunned the engine to loose a little more speed out of the bike.

He didn’t know much about the Old Alpha aside from that, he had kept well away from the pack, as most Alpha’s do, more than one Alpha within a territory doesn’t mix well. Packs tent to steer clear of one another, through have been known to pass through the same area. But meeting, well that is another story, mostly you just get the scent of a pack passing through. But if this was Sowain’s Sire and shit he knew Sowain predated the US itself then he must be old. As he came around the corner Brock could see Patricia’s bike on the side of the road, she hadn’t left yet. Good, he pulled over himself but put the bike farther into the trees as not to be seen. He would wait until she went by and then follow them to get the address, if he was lucky he would attribute his scent to having been there earlier in the day, she was significantly younger then he was so she had not learned quite how to discern deteriorating smells from fresh ones.

Patricia

Patricia crouched in the woods watching the visitors center, Officers had passed close by her location but they never saw her, they were like children when playing in the woods, she had not known that as a human, it was not until she had been embraced that she truly learned what it meant to be a child of nature, Humans had lost most of their ability to sense in the woods, they were no longer predator or prey, they just existed, consumers of their own intellect. They were easy prey but Sowain was specific about which ones they could or could not take. She would be less strict if she could be, but he was the pack leader and you did not go against the pack leader if you knew what was good for you. He had seen the results of what happened when you challenged someone as old as Sowain, it made their little display on the beach today look like child’s play.

She watched as the humans went back and forth from the building to go about their different tasks, She had kept her human form for this as hunting was not needed and being young sometimes it was hard to ensure that the human mind was in control instead of that of the wolf. When turned she could feel both warring for control, Sowain had told her that the older she got the easier it would be to control herself and to allow her human intellect to reign over the change. But until then she only ever turned when in the pack where she could be guided and watched.

About an hour later the human she was waiting for left the Visitor center alone and headed into the parking lot, he was going for his car, what a break she would be able to get his address and then head back and report to Sowain, the job done. She silently made her way back to the bike and waited for his car to drive by.
